incidents.summary: QinetiQ was fined £800,000 after inadequate risk assessment of an ammunition trial at Pendine resulted in an employee being shot and paralysed below the shoulders.

sources.title: Defence company fined £800,000 after man paralysed by bullet
sources.quote: A defence technology company has been fined £800,000 after an employee was paralysed by a bullet during a test of NATO ammunition.

sources.title: Defence company fined £800,000 after man paralysed by bullet
sources.quote: An investigation by the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) found QinetiQ Limited had failed to perform an adequate risk assessment of the trial.

sources.title: Man paralysed after being shot during weapons test at Pendine MoD range – The Pembrokeshire Herald
sources.quote: The company was also ordered to pay £8,365.40 in costs and a £190 victim surcharge, bringing the total penalty to £808,555.40.
